first_answer: An LLM (Large Language Model) server batches requests to improve efficiency and scalability. By processing multiple requests simultaneously, the server can handle more queries per unit of time, reducing wait times for users and optimizing resource utilization. This approach also helps in managing memory usage effectively, as it avoids unnecessary storage overhead associated with individual request handling. Additionally, batching allows for better load balancing across servers, ensuring that no single machine becomes overwhelmed while others remain underutilized.
